cases_nycity <- cases_nycity %>% mutate(
  
  death_per_case = deaths/confirmed_cases
)




ggplot(cases_nycity, aes(x = date, y = death_per_case)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_smooth() +
  labs(y = "deaths per case")
